claim: For every nonempty simple fair family of 3-subsets of six symbols, independently drawn uniformly with replacement, the expected time to cover every symbol is at most \(157/36\), with equality exactly for a \(2\)-\((6,3,2)\) design. The full 20-triple support has expectation \(327/76\), so the sharp excess is \(10/171\). Among nonempty simple fair 3-subset mechanisms, six is the least number of symbols at which the full mechanism fails to maximize expected coverage time.
integrity_note: The extremal bound follows from a complete analytic pair-codegree reduction and strict discrete convexity. Exact rational computational checks support the finite identities but are not used as a substitute for the proof. Historical priority and proof have not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted uniform sampling from a nonempty simple 3-uniform equal-vertex-degree support is considered; no result is asserted for larger alphabets, weighted supports, repeated blocks, or full distributional order.
title: Sharp fair triple-draw coupon coverage on six symbols
